name: aws
title: AWS
description: An AWS access key, for S3 buckets.
needed_for: Reads and writes the objects of your S3 buckets, including dataset rows kept in S3.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.label: Secret access key
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.hint: Shown once, when the access key is created (IAM → Security credentials).

AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.label: Session token
AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.hint: Only for temporary keys (AWS SSO, an assumed role). Leave empty for a long-lived access key.
